items.details:
📢 ADRE 3.0 — Official Notification NOT Yet Released (as of August 5, 2026)

The Assam Direct Recruitment Examination (ADRE) 3.0 for Grade 3 and Grade 4 posts is one of the most anticipated recruitments in Assam. While multiple reports suggest 10,000 to 15,000 vacancies are being planned under the State Level Recruitment Commission (SLRC), no official notification date has been confirmed yet.

  • Grade 3 Posts: LDA, Junior Assistant, DEO, etc. (requires Graduation/HS)
  • Grade 4 Posts: Peon, Chowkidar, Office Attendant, etc. (requires Class 8/10)
  • Candidates should prepare using the syllabus and exam pattern from ADRE 2.0
  • ⚠️ Beware of misinformation on social media. Only trust official sources.

Official portals to monitor: sebaonline.org and assam.gov.in

items.title: SBI Probationary Officer (PO) 2026 — 1,500 Vacancies | Apply Now
items.education: Any Graduate from a recognized University (Final year students may also apply)
items.details:
🔥 Mega Banking Recruitment: State Bank of India has officially released the SBI PO 2026 notification (Advertisement No: CRPD/PO/2026-27/09) for 1,500 Probationary Officer vacancies.

Key Highlights:

  • 1,446 fresh vacancies + 54 backlog vacancies across all categories.
  • Phase-I (Prelims) scheduled for August 2026.
  • Phase-II (Mains) scheduled for September 2026.
  • Phase-III includes Psychometric Test, Group Exercises & Personal Interview in Oct/Nov 2026.

Candidates must complete their One-Time Registration (OTR) on the SBI careers portal before applying.
items.other_details: Age Limit: 21-30 years as on 01-04-2026. Upper age relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC. Selection through 3-phase process: Preliminary Exam (100 marks, 1 hour), Main Exam (225 marks, 3 hours), and Interview/GD.
